item.title: America250: Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square featured in 'America's Soundtrack'
item.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square is featured in "America's Soundtrack," a commemoration of the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Salt Lake man jailed after buying adult toy for 12-year-old girl he 'had a crush on'
item.description: A Salt Lake man has been arrested and charged for allegedly purchasing an adult sex toy for a 12-year-old girl. He admitted to police that the victim "looked at him like he was a monster" after receiving it.

item.title: Man arrested for robbing Salt Lake City phone store and threatening employee at gunpoint
item.description: A man living in South Salt Lake is accused of stealing nearly $29,000 of product from an AT&T store while threatening an employee at gunpoint.

item.title: Utah family shares experience being in Tel Aviv during missile strikes
item.description: Thirty-three members of a Utah family returned safely home Wednesday after being stuck in Tel Aviv during Iranian missile strikes in the country. The family’s trip was decades in the making and dedicated to the family’s late matriarch.

item.title: Officials identify victims of Wayne County triple homicide
item.description: Police have identified the three victims of a triple homicide in Wayne County on Wednesday.

item.title: DHHS urges residents to vaccinate against measles
item.description: With measles cases rising in Utah, the Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is asking residents to get vaccinated.

item.title: Local organization provides hiking safety tips for women
item.description: After two women were killed while hiking in Wayne County in a murder spree that killed one other, ABC4 spoke with a local hiking organization on some general hiking safety tips.

item.title: Man arrested for child kidnapping after grabbing two children outside of apartment
item.description: A man has been arrested and booked into jail after allegedly grabbing two children while they were taking the trash out from their apartment.

item.title: 24-year-old arrested, accused of sexually assaulting Park City High School student
item.description: An adult man has been arrested after being accused of sexually assaulting a 14-year-old Park City High School student.

item.title: Neighbors demand answers after deadly crash on unfinished road
item.description: Neighbors are fired up about a dirt road along 4100 South and 8400 West, that they say was supposed to be fixed up years ago. After a 15-year-old died in a rollover crash earlier this week, many say this long-standing safety concerns need to be addressed.
